newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia posts 1996 trade gap of 617.97 mln.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia posts 1996 trade gap of 617.97 mln.

text.p: Malaysia recorded a 1996 trade deficit of 617.97 million ringgit and a trade surplus of 872 million ringgit in December 1996, the Statistics Department said on Tuesday.
The monthly surplus was against a surplus of 637.34 million in December 1995 and a gap of 526.4 million in November 1996. In 1995, Malaysia posted a deficit of 9.36 billion ringgit.
The 1996 gap was significantly less than the deficit of 5.2 billion ringgit forecast in the Finance Ministry's Economic Report released last October.
The department said exports last year totalled 196.69 billion ringgit, up by 6.3 percent from 1995. Imports were 197.31 billion ringgit, up by 1.5 percent from 1995.
